_comment: MEADOWS-VISUAL-PASS round 5. Runtime-only terrain shader values for the Meadows ground, merged over terrain_playground.json's `shader` block by playground_world.gd::_apply_ground_shader. Separate because terrain_playground.json fingerprints the terrain and scatter bakes, and none of this moves a vertex or a placement.

shader._comment_macro: The macro variation colours multiply the whole ground. At #b8b58c/#8ea369 they darkened and yellowed it into large olive and mustard blotches: measured on the survey's ground band at saturation 0.86-0.95 and value 0.34-0.45, against 0.52-0.66 and 0.49-0.60 across the Palworld references. Taking them most of the way to white (a render A/B through tools/survey.gd at 01, 02 and 04) brought the ground to saturation 0.62-0.70 and value 0.60-0.64 and kept a soft large-scale variation. TUNABLE. A second pass took a little red out of both (#dde3c8/#cfdfc6): at the first values the lit meadow rendered a yellow-lime (hue 62) and the paths orange.
shader._comment_aerial: The terrain's own distance fade (terrain_ground.gdshader) desaturated the far plain by 0.55 on top of the fog, which read as a white wall from the overlook. Halved, so distance stays green under the haze. TUNABLE.
